news.detail: Slye split the uprights on a 33-yard try in the third quarter, notching his fourth field-goal make of the season. The kicker has had limited opportunities with Tennessee, going 4-for-5 on field-goal attempts, including 0-for-1 from 50-plus yards, over four contests so far during the 2026 campaign.
